outcome: VAS scores at 30 and 60 minutes post-extubation
cohort: 60 women undergoing total laparoscopic hysterectomy at a tertiary referral center
finding: Paracervical block with bupivacaine was effective in reducing immediate postoperative pain after total laparoscopic hysterectomy, resulting in a 25% reduction in mean VAS score and a 47% reduction in opioid consumption in the first hour.
